episodes.title: INSPIRE 617 - Lisa Phillips, A Survivor - Epstein survior Lisa Phillips tells her story.
episodes.description:
On this episode of Inspire, we feature a conversation with Lisa Phillips, Jeffrey Epstein Survivor and International Advocate. Lisa Phillips is a survivor of sexual abuse and trafficking by convicted felon, Jeffrey Epstein, an international model, actress and prominent survivor advocate.

Aired: 07/09/2026
